install_semantics.guard: Android keeps ONE base.apk per package shared by all users (e.g. user 0 and dual-app user 0, 95). This install REPLACED that single shared APK for ALL listed users at once: after this point every launch on ANY user runs the NEW artifact. Crashes observed after this point — on any user, including the dual-app profile — belong to the NEW artifact and are NEVER evidence that the replaced build crashes by itself.
